# Manifest format

Every finalised episode folder holds `manifest.json`: each of its
files with its size and SHA-256. Format `kapto.manifest`, version 1.

## Completeness rule

An episode folder is complete only when all of these hold:

1. It contains `_FINALISED`. Kapto writes it last, after the
   manifest, so a folder without it was interrupted.
2. It contains a `manifest.json` with format `kapto.manifest`.
3. The files in the folder and its subfolders, apart from
   `manifest.json` and `_FINALISED`, are exactly the listed
   ones, each with its listed size and SHA-256.

Paths use `/` between folders and are sorted. An episode folder holds
only regular files and folders, no links. New versions only add
fields; a reader that finds a version newer than it knows treats the
manifest as unreadable rather than guess.

## JSON Schema

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Manifest",
  "description": "Every file of a finalised episode, with its size and SHA-256.",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "episode": {
      "description": "The episode's ID, the same as its folder name.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "files": {
      "description": "Every file in the episode folder and its subfolders, except\n`manifest.json` and `_FINALISED`, sorted by path.",
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/FileEntry"
      }
    },
    "format": {
      "description": "Always `\"kapto.manifest\"`.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "version": {
      "description": "The format version; versions only ever add fields.",
      "type": "integer",
      "format": "uint32",
      "minimum": 0
    }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "required": [
    "format",
    "version",
    "episode",
    "files"
  ],
  "$defs": {
    "FileEntry": {
      "description": "One file of an episode.",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "bytes": {
          "description": "The file's size in bytes.",
          "type": "integer",
          "format": "uint64",
          "minimum": 0
        },
        "path": {
          "description": "The path from the episode folder, with `/` between folders.",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "sha256": {
          "description": "The SHA-256 of the file's contents, as 64 lowercase hex digits.",
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "required": [
        "path",
        "bytes",
        "sha256"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```
